# Code of Conduct

This code applies to all collaboration spaces of this repository (Issues, Pull Requests, review discussions). It is drafted in the spirit of the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/).

## Ground Rules

- Communicate professionally and respectfully; address the issue, not the person.
- Differing opinions and constructive technical disagreement are welcome; back up counterarguments with evidence.
- Respect the time of maintainers and reviewers: self-review before submitting, and respond promptly to review feedback.

## Unacceptable Behavior

**Malicious contributions:**

- Deliberately submitting destructive code or intentionally planting defects;
- Maliciously introducing security vulnerabilities or backdoors;
- Filing large volumes of meaningless Issues / Pull Requests, or farming commits through automation.

**Intellectual property violations:**

- Submitting unauthorized third-party code;
- Submitting content that infringes copyrights, patents, or trade secrets of others;
- Being unable to warrant that you have the right to license your contribution to this project.

**Other:** personal attacks, harassment, disclosure of others' private information, and similar general misconduct.

## Reporting and Enforcement

If you observe a violation of this code, email **harken-support@xd.com**. Report security issues privately as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Maintainers may remove, close, or revert violating content and restrict participation when necessary.
